integrity: Analytical proof covers all admissible parameters. Exact finite checks are corroborative; historical novelty and ecological model validity are not independently certified.
limitations: Three plant species, identical integer partner degree, pollinator richness 3d-2s, and d>=2s; no claim outside this class.
Pollinators fail independently with identical probability; a plant remains supported if any partner survives.
Disconnected networks are allowed, and the paired-module optimizer is disconnected.
No demographic feedback, interaction strength, adaptive rewiring, heterogeneous failure, or empirical performance inference is established.
Literature priority requires independent verification, including inaccessible set-system primary full text.
title: Optimal shared-core versus paired-module pollination reliability at a sharp extinction threshold
